metadata.title: Reference Lane External-Read Exception & Provenance Audit
metadata.milestone: Phase 2R.2 — Public Reference Pinning & Evidence-Derivation Closure

policy_statement.isolation_status: Lane A source reconstruction remained strictly isolated. Lane B reference reads were explicitly quarantined to reference analysis and did not write into reconstructed_source/.
policy_statement.provenance_correction: During Phase 2R, local checkout d:/ScrcpyOverWebRTC was read while at commit 79201f4... with dirty state, while documentation attributed it to pinned public commit 65567d.... This mismatch has been formally audited, rejected as canonical reference, and replaced with exact git blob extraction from public commit 65567d777bccb11d2a6d93b6acc735478e880b5b.
policy_statement.future_enforcement: All reference extraction tools read exclusively from immutable local snapshots in evidence/reference/raw/ verified against PUBLIC_REFERENCE_TREE_MANIFEST.json. Mutable external checkouts are decoupled and never accessed.

external_access_records.remediation_status: All 8 frontend files rematerialized directly from git commit 65567d777bccb11d2a6d93b6acc735478e880b5b into evidence/reference/raw/web-app/ with matching Git blob SHAs.
All 4 doc files verified identical to git commit ceb66b20ad4c6f7b217d38852ea9ec2bd70fcd39 in evidence/reference/raw/docs/.
